tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Page ground. Cream (AcreageByCounty, FieldExtractor, CIP) or the navy of the LUA dashboard.

tokens.name: bg-card
tokens.usage: Masthead, side rail, panels, menus and popups that sit on bg-page.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Insets: input wells, code chips, KPI band cells. Text on it is text-ink or text-heading; text-muted is only 4.4:1 here.

tokens.name: bg-inverse
tokens.usage: Banners and toasts that sit over the map; text on it is text-inverse.

tokens.name: text-ink
tokens.usage: Body text on bg-page and bg-card (13.5:1 cream / 12.8:1 navy).

tokens.name: text-heading
tokens.usage: Titles, KPI values, county and feature names: the seal navy.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, units, meta lines, footers on bg-page or bg-card (4.8:1 cream, 8.9:1 navy). Not on bg-sunken (4.4:1): use text-ink there.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Eyebrows and section labels in sage (4.7:1 cream, 6.6:1 navy). Use this, not brand-sage, for text: brand-sage is 2.9:1 on cream.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on bg-inverse, action-primary and dark data fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: rail edges, list dividers, KPI grid gaps, input borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outline-button borders and hover borders; dividers that must be seen.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Seal navy (logo .st1). Identity colour: headers, primary actions, Bexar County fill.

tokens.name: brand-cream
tokens.usage: Fixed cream, the same in both themes: text on dept-admin and other dark department headers.

tokens.name: brand-sage
tokens.usage: Seal sage (logo .st2). Masthead rule, spinners, toggles, Kendall County fill. Not for small text.

tokens.name: brand-sage-hover
tokens.usage: Hover for sage fills (ArcGIS calcite-color-brand-hover).

tokens.name: brand-amber
tokens.usage: Warm accent: Comal County fill, highlight strokes, the dark editors' accent.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Annexation and export highlights (MapExport, AnnexationHistory). Fills and strokes only.

tokens.name: brand-tan
tokens.usage: City palette tan (CIP). Soft fills and map backgrounds.

tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: City palette light blue (CIP). Water features and quiet fills.

tokens.name: brand-olive-deep
tokens.usage: City palette deep olive (CIP). Drainage features; a darker sage for fills.

tokens.name: brand-brick
tokens.usage: City palette brick (CIP). Buildings, and the base of status-error.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button and the active segment. Light: navy with white (15:1); dark: sage with navy text (4.8:1).

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of action-primary.

tokens.name: action-primary-text
tokens.usage: Label on action-primary.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, offset 2px, on every interactive element (4.7:1 on cream).

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Saved, valid and published messages; success tags.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Neutral progress and info messages. 4.2:1 on bg-page (flagged): place info text on bg-card (4.6:1).

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and pending states. 3.6:1 on cream (flagged, from FieldExtractor's gold): pair with an icon or bold 14px+ text.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Errors, failed sign-in, destructive actions (5.3:1 cream / 6.7:1 navy).

tokens.name: status-success-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a success status bar or tag.

tokens.name: status-info-wash
tokens.usage: Background of an info status bar or tag.

tokens.name: status-warning-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a warning status bar or tag.

tokens.name: status-error-wash
tokens.usage: Background of an error status bar or tag.

tokens.name: sage-wash
tokens.usage: Sage tint: badges, the checked toggle track, the focus halo on inputs.

tokens.name: dept-admin
tokens.usage: Administration profile: forest-green header (Drainage, AnnexationHistory, MapExport, CIP header).

tokens.name: dept-admin-soft
tokens.usage: Administration profile hover and secondary fill.

tokens.name: dept-engineering
tokens.usage: Engineering Services 'Graphite Steel' profile, Governance Amendment 01: app ground.

tokens.name: dept-engineering-steel
tokens.usage: Graphite Steel accent (Amendment 01): rules, active states, buttons.

tokens.name: dept-emergency
tokens.usage: Emergency Management (EOC) profile slate: panels on #101b2d.

tokens.name: county-bexar
tokens.usage: Acreage by County: Bexar. Navy on Cream, cream in the Navy theme so it stays visible on the dark ground; map symbology itself stays seal navy.

tokens.name: county-kendall
tokens.usage: Acreage by County: Kendall.

tokens.name: county-comal
tokens.usage: Acreage by County: Comal (fixed in both themes).

tokens.name: county-other
tokens.usage: Acreage by County: other or unassigned.

tokens.name: cip-water
tokens.usage: CIP category: Water.

tokens.name: cip-wastewater
tokens.usage: CIP category: Wastewater. Navy on Cream, cream in the Navy theme so it stays visible on the dark ground; map symbology itself stays seal navy.

tokens.name: cip-roadway
tokens.usage: CIP category: Roadway.

tokens.name: cip-drainage
tokens.usage: CIP category: Drainage.

tokens.name: cip-building
tokens.usage: CIP category: Building / facilities.

tokens.name: sev-0
tokens.usage: EOC severity 0: normal / open.

tokens.name: sev-1
tokens.usage: EOC severity 1: advisory. Navy text on it, never white.

tokens.name: sev-2
tokens.usage: EOC severity 2: caution.

tokens.name: sev-3
tokens.usage: EOC severity 3: closed / danger.

tokens.name: sev-4
tokens.usage: EOC severity 4: critical. Severity is also labelled in words, never colour alone.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: KPI values in the stat band.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Per-item figures in the rail and popups.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sign in with your ArcGIS Online account to edit.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Rail intros, meta lines, help text.
styles.sample: Totals use the Parcels layer, GIS acres.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: UPPERCASE, in text-accent: the line above a title or KPI.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Field names, item IDs, inline code chips.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tag margins.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls, between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (x), small stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Masthead gap, list-item padding, panel stacks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Side-rail and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter: masthead, KPI band, footer.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section breaks on full pages.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, legend swatches.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, segmented options, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, menus, popups.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Progress bands, toggles, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Panels and the sticky header.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Raised cards on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Map widgets floating on the map (export button).

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the map banner.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: App header height (editors). Map pages size the masthead by content.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Right-hand rail beside the map (AcreageByCounty).

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Left editor panel (CIP, ParcelEditor, WaterMeterEditor).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of form-style tools (FieldExtractor).

tokens.name: breakpoint-stack
tokens.usage: Below this width the rail stacks under the map.
